description: This file implements functions related to the VoiceService component in the RdkTelcoVoiceManager, including getters and setters for parameters, table management, and synchronization logic for voice services and their parameters within a telecommunications device firmware. It appears to be part of a data model interface that interacts with underlying data and control layers in a C-based embedded system.

classes.name: PTELCOVOICEMGR_DATAMODEL_SERVICES
classes.description: Pointer to the data model structure for voice services, representing the collection of voice service instances.

classes.name: PTELCOVOICEMGR_DML_SERVICES
classes.description: Pointer to the data model structure for the collection of voice services.

classes.name: PDML_VOICE_SERVICE_CTRL_T
classes.description: Pointer to the control structure for a specific voice service instance, containing data and control info.

methods.name: BOOL VoiceService_IsUpdated(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Checks whether the voice service table has been updated; in this implementation, always returns TRUE.

methods.name: ULONG VoiceService_Synchronize(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Synchronizes the voice service table; in this implementation, simply returns 0 indicating success.

methods.name: ULONG VoiceService_GetEntryCount(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Returns the number of voice service entries present, based on the internal data model.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE VoiceService_GetEntry(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,ULONG nIndex,ULONG * pInsNumber)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific voice service entry by index, returning a handle to the data structure.

methods.name: BOOL VoiceService_GetParamUlongValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,ULONG * puLong)
methods.description: Gets the ULONG value of a specific parameter ('X_RDK_Status' or 'X_RDK_Enable') for a voice service instance.

methods.name: BOOL VoiceService_SetParamUlongValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,ULONG uValue)
methods.description: Sets the ULONG value of a parameter ('X_RDK_Enable') in a voice service instance.

methods.name: BOOL VoiceService_GetParamBoolValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,BOOL * pBool)
methods.description: Retrieves boolean parameters ('X_RDK_FactoryReset', 'X_RDK_DisableLoopCurrentUntilRegistered', 'X_RDK_OngoingEmergencyCall') for a voice service instance.

methods.name: BOOL VoiceService_SetParamBoolValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,BOOL bValue)
methods.description: Sets boolean parameters ('X_RDK_DisableLoopCurrentUntilRegistered', 'X_RDK_FactoryReset') for a voice service instance.

methods.name: ULONG VoiceService_GetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * pValue,ULONG * pulSize)
methods.description: Retrieves string parameters such as IP address family, IP address, interface name, alias, firewall rule data, and local timezone for a voice service instance.

methods.name: BOOL VoiceService_SetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * pString)
methods.description: Sets string parameters like interface name, IP address family, and alias for a voice service instance.

methods.name: BOOL VoiceService_Validate(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Validates the current data model state before applying updates; currently always returns TRUE.

methods.name: BOOL VoiceService_Commit(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Commits all pending changes to the voice service data; currently a stub returning 0.

methods.name: BOOL VoiceService_Rollback(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Reverts any uncommitted changes to the voice service data; currently a stub returning 0.
